Your rooks and bishop control the open position, but Black's queen on f2 is the most dangerous piece. Rf3+ forks the king and queen—it checks the king on f6 while attacking the undefended queen on f2. Black must move the king to escape check, allowing you to capture the queen with Rxf2, winning material decisively. Here, the exposed king and loose queen made this fork unstoppable.
